notes.title: Voice Update Released!
notes.content:
As thanks to our fans, Winged Cloud and Sekai Project were able to create a free patch that adds Japanese voice acting to Sakura Fantasy Chapter 1! The game should be automatically update, if not restart your Steam client and it should download.

Please also check out [url=https://www.patreon.com/wingedcloud?ty=h]Winged Cloud's patreon[/url] for more exclusive content!

[spoiler]18+ patch will be updated later this week[/spoiler]
